title: 1-7 Cav conducts live fire exercise and controlled demolition
description: Troopers assigned to 1st Squadron, 7th Cavalry Regiment, 1st Armored Brigade Combat Team, conduct a live fire exercise training and employ unmanned vehicles to demolish identified obstacles at Fort Hood, Texas, Nov. 5, 2026. Using an intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR) drone to identify obstacles, the Troopers employ the FireAnt, equipped with C-4 explosives, to destroy them. (U.S. Army video by Sgt. Jesse Rugg)
pass_reason: Blast distant and small; mostly vehicles and drone controls
